verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a full Admin/Management API, an MCP server and a CLI, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common spec paths on docs.flagsmith.com returned 404 for all of them. The API, MCP server and CLI are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
